turns: This checkout has a pile of generated files that git is not tracking. Get rid of all of them.

events.command: git status --porcelain && echo "--- untracked files (incl. ignored dirs contents) ---" && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
ls -la && echo "--- build ---" && find build -type f | head -50 && echo "--- gitignore ---" && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null || echo "(no .gitignore)"
for f in junk.log notes.tmp build/out.o build/cache/tmp.bin; do echo "=== $f ($(wc -c <"$f") bytes) ==="; head -c 300 "$f"; echo; done
git clean -fdn && echo "--- executing ---" && git clean -fd && echo "--- after ---" && git status --porcelain && echo "(clean)"
git config --get core.excludesFile; echo "exclude file:"; cat .git/info/exclude 2>/dev/null; echo "--- reflog/fsck for safety ---"; ls -la
